Name: Strategic Alignment
Description: The proposal contributes directly to the goals of the IT Strategic Plan 2026-2028, in particular end-to-end process digitalization.

Name: Measurable Financial Benefits
Description: Benefits expressed in euros or hours saved, with a stated baseline and a verifiable calculation method.

Name: Process Impact
Description: Number of users, suppliers or cases involved and a concrete reduction in time, manual steps or errors.

Name: Feasibility and Risk
Description: Realistic plan with phases and a pilot, identified dependencies, main risks described with their mitigations.

Name: Platform Reuse
Description: Use of platforms the company already licenses (Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365) instead of new products.

Name: Cyber Risk Reduction
Description: Measurable reduction of the attack surface or of the likelihood and impact of incidents, with reference to risks already on record.

Name: Regulatory Compliance
Description: Explicit coverage of NIS2, GDPR or internal audit requirements, stating the gaps the proposal closes.

Name: User Impact
Description: Effects on users' daily operations and measures to limit them (communication, maintenance windows, support).

Name: Feasibility and Risk
Description: Realistic plan with phases, available skills, dependencies and project risks with mitigations.

Name: Recurring Operating Costs
Description: Annual running costs (licenses, managed services, staff) stated and sustainable over time.

Name: Business Value of the Use Case
Description: Clear business problem, identified target users and a quantified expected benefit.

Name: Data Quality and Availability
Description: Identified data sources, data owner, and enough quality and history for the use case.

Name: Responsible AI and Privacy

Name: Measurable Outcomes
